releaseNotes.summary: The final Beta 0.3 build: bug reports arrive as a reviewed email draft, Juno discovers signed future updates, and every companion orb animates its thinking in both Bot and Code mode.
highlights: Help & feedback prepares a complete email to the Juno owner in your own mail app; you review it and press Send yourself.
Settings → Updates checks a signed feed and shows the released version and notes, with a manual install route for the unsigned installer.
Orb thinking and working animations now run in both Bot and Code mode with one shared character language.
Long reports are shortened visibly to fit a mail link; Copy and Save keep the complete document.
improvements: Code mode reports planning, working, approval, complete and failed states through the same orb and status line.
Custom-coloured bots keep their animation running across unrelated re-renders.
Crash records stay on this PC and are offered as a reviewed draft on the next launch.
fixes: Removed the reporting-service dependency that made Send Report inactive.
Removed the automatic crash-report switch that implied unattended delivery.
knownIssues: The Windows installer is unsigned; automatic installation of unsigned updates is intentionally disabled.
rc.17 and earlier cannot discover this release; one manual install is required.
Phone and Tailscale connectivity are deferred for Beta 0.3.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows x64. Existing Beta profiles upgrade in place; keep the previous installer to roll back.
